dossiers.ai_export_description: Generates an export folder containing dossier data, templates, and AI instructions. Open it with Claude Code or a compatible AI tool to create new documents, then import them back using the Import tab.
dossiers.ai_export_step1: Enable anonymization if you want to mask sensitive data before sharing the folder.
dossiers.ai_export_step2: Click 'Export for AI' and choose a destination folder.
dossiers.ai_export_step3: Open the exported AI folder with Claude Code: run claude inside the AI directory.
dossiers.ai_export_step4: Ask the AI to create documents — it writes them directly at the root of the AI folder.
dossiers.ai_export_step5: Come back to the Import tab to import the created files.
dossiers.ai_import_description: Select the exported AI folder to import the files created by the AI. Pseudonyms are replaced with real dossier data, and Ordicab macros ({{ }}) are resolved automatically. Imported files are indexed in your dossier.

cowork.pageSubtitle: Hand this dossier to Claude Cowork without exposing a single real identity: one-click pseudonymized export, reimport with automatic identity restoration.
cowork.step1Body: Ordicab creates the Cowork subfolder with a dossier synthesis and the text of every document, where all identities are replaced by stable fake identities (the client is always “Camille Dupont”…).
cowork.step2Title: Open the Cowork folder in Claude
cowork.step2Body: In Claude Cowork, open the exported folder. The instructions (CLAUDE.md) tell it to read dossier.md first and write every deliverable as Markdown into resultats/.
cowork.step3Body: Analyses, draft pleadings, summaries… Claude works on the fake identities as if they were real.
cowork.step4Body: The “Reimport” button restores the real identities in each deliverable and saves it into the dossier (Résultats Cowork).
cowork.privacyBody: The Cowork folder contains pseudonymized text only: no original document is copied, and the mapping table stays local in the dossier (.ordicab), never exported. Re-exports keep the same fake identities; work in progress in resultats/ is preserved.
cowork.title: Claude Cowork (anonymized)
cowork.description: Exports a pseudonymized copy of the dossier (synthesis + document text) into the Cowork subfolder. Claude Cowork writes its deliverables to resultats/; reimporting restores the real identities.
cowork.exportDone: Export complete: {{count}} document(s) exported, {{skipped}} not extracted.
cowork.reimportEmpty: No results to reimport from resultats/.
cowork.neverExported: Never exported — exporting creates a pseudonymized copy of the dossier.
personas.title: Role-based fake identities
personas.description: Whatever the dossier, each role is impersonated by the same fake identity (the client is always “Camille Dupont”…).
personas.minLength: Every first and last name must use words of at least 4 characters (reversibility constraint).
delegated.reference.title: AI Reference
delegated.reference.subtitle: All operations you can ask Claude to perform
delegated.offline.title: Offline workflow with Claude Code
delegated.offline.subtitle: To create or analyze documents with direct access to dossier files, use the AI export workflow.
delegated.offline.step1: In the dossier detail, go to the AI Export tab and click 'Export for AI'.
delegated.offline.step2: Open the exported folder in a terminal and run claude to start a Claude Code session.
delegated.offline.step3: Ask Claude to read the dossier data and create documents at the root of the AI folder.
delegated.offline.step4: Back in Ordicab, open the AI Import tab and import the created files — Ordicab macros and pseudonyms are resolved automatically.
